PM2.5 sensor with numerical display
Very quiet in Sleep mode (about 20 dB)
Carbon layer helps with cooking smells
cons: CADR of 250 m³/h limits it to bedrooms and small living rooms
Replacement filter costs more than the AC0920's

Cheaper replacement filter than the AC0950
cons: No carbon layer, so weak on smells and gases
skipIf: you cook near the bedroom or want app control

Rated filter life of about 9,000 hours
cons: CADR of 152 m³/h is only enough for small rooms

skipIf: your room is over about 150 sq ft or you live in a city with severe winter smog
